name: zzu-xcpc-db
description: 郑州大学 XCPC 历年赛事奖项档案，使用纯静态页面部署到 GitHub Pages。

scripts.clean-data: node scripts/clean-data.mjs data/srk-results.json && node scripts/clean-data.mjs data/manual-results.json
scripts.build: npm run clean-data && npm run merge-contests && npm test && npm run build-data && vite build
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts docs README.md package.json vite.config.js index.html .github/workflows/pages.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts docs README.md package.json vite.config.js index.html .github/workflows/pages.yml
